notes:
Company profile: Nova Marsh Intelligence — legal discovery / enterprise search vendor; processes historic case files, contracts, regulatory filings. ~48M source documents across PDFs, images (OCR), and structured metadata. Primary requirement: all customer data must stay within UK or EU datacenters (UK residency preferred). Multi-region read/failover acceptable but writes + index updates must be in-region.

Use-case summary: hybrid pipeline — approximate nearest neighbor (FAISS/HNSW) read from in-region vector store for candidate retrieval, then cross-encoder rerank for top-10 results. High QPS during office-hours: target sustained 200-300 qps with spikes to 1k qps for short windows. Latency targets: P95 end-to-end search <= 120ms (hard cap), allow reranker tail up to additional 40ms but prefer <200ms total for complex queries. Cost sensitivity: pushing for cost-per-query < $0.01 at scale; seed ARR expected if POC succeeds.

Technical constraints & preferences: prefer embeddings at 1536 dim for compatibility; exploring sparse+dense hybrid indices. Rerankers: interested in small cross-encoders optimized/quantized (INT8) or Redwood-provided low-latency variants. Prefers dedicated capacity or private deployment to ensure predictable latency and residency. Wants autoscaling but with strict cold-start controls.
